content.title: Source Code
content.content: IoT Telemetry Ingestion & Transactional Billing Engine (C# / .NET / Redis / PostgreSQL / Docker). Built a highly scalable modular monolith from scratch to handle asynchronous data streaming and robust financial transaction processing. Features cryptographically signed payloads using HMAC-SHA256 to block Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks and data tampering at the network gateway layer. Optimized persistent database write performance by implementing a highload batching engine via ConcurrentQueue and a background PeriodicTimer scheduler, reducing hard disk I/O stress by flushing bulk inserts to PostgreSQL every 5 seconds. Incorporates atomic Redis memory cache workflows to maintain single-source-of-truth account balances while enforcing strict database unique constraints on composite idempotency keys to ensure absolute protection against double-billing during automatic network retries.

projects.title: find_way_C++
projects.description: It can get boring while traveling, so I decided to build a pathfinding algorithm on my smartphone using Processing. All elements and algorithms are rendered via code. This version uses the breadth-first search algorithm.

projects.title: Local storage for students
projects.description: A project developed for the university where I worked. It was designed for offline file sharing between students and classrooms. Students could upload files to a local cloud and work on their projects from almost any classroom.

projects.title: Local student certificate request system.
projects.description: Students can request certificates online, track the approval and signing process, and receive a remote notification once the document is ready for pickup. Administrators can manage certificate types. Features automatic generation of printable PDF files.

projects.title: Video analytics system.
projects.description: A campus security project designed to enhance performance and log disciplinary infractions. Using MediaPipe, the system analyzes camera feeds; if aggression or smoking is detected, it alerts security personnel and saves frames of the violation to the database.

projects.title: Local sawmill website.
projects.description: An e-commerce platform where users can build a shopping cart and place orders. Features credit card number validation implemented with the Luhn algorithm.
